# Provider reference

PyGeoVision reaches **22 data providers** through [pygeofetch](https://pygeofetch.readthedocs.io/). This page lists every one with what it serves, whether you need an account, and whether it offers radar, sub-metre imagery or a STAC API. It is generated from the provider registry, so it always matches the installed version.

10 providers need no account. The default search uses `planetary_computer`, `aws_earth`, `element84`: a plain `client.search(...)` therefore works on a fresh install.

## How to choose

1. **Start with the defaults.** For Sentinel-2, Landsat, DEMs, land cover and Sentinel-1 RTC, `planetary_computer` is open and complete.
2. **Add a provider when the default lacks the product**: Sentinel-1 GRD (raw radar) comes from `copernicus` or `alaska_satellite_facility`; sub-metre commercial imagery from `planet`, `maxar_gbdx` or `airbus_oneatlas`; elevation lidar from `opentopography`.
3. **Restrict explicitly** with `providers=[...]` (Python) or `--provider NAME` (CLI, repeatable) when you want a reproducible source. An unknown name is rejected by the search layer.
4. **Authenticate** the ones marked with an account requirement: `pygeovision data auth add <provider>` ([Authentication](authentication.md)).

## All providers

| ID | Name | Account | Radar | ≤ 1 m | STAC | Serves |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `usgs` | USGS Earth Explorer | Username and password | no | no | no | Landsat 1-9, ASTER, MODIS |
| `copernicus` | Copernicus CDSE | OAuth2 (client id / secret or account) | yes | no | yes | Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3, Sentinel-5P |
| `nasa_earthdata` | NASA Earthdata CMR | OAuth2 (client id / secret or account) | no | no | yes | MODIS, VIIRS, ICESat-2, GEDI |
| `nasa_earthdata_cloud` | NASA Earthdata Cloud | OAuth2 plus temporary S3 credentials | no | no | yes | All NASA cloud-hosted datasets |
| `opentopography` | OpenTopography | API key | no | no | no | SRTM, Copernicus DEM, ALOS, LiDAR |
| `planet` | Planet Labs | API key | no | yes | yes | PlanetScope, SkySat, RapidEye |
| `sentinel_hub` | Sentinel Hub | OAuth2 (client id / secret or account) | yes | no | no | Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3, Landsat, MODIS |
| `maxar_gbdx` | Maxar GBDX | Access token | no | yes | no | WorldView-1, WorldView-2, WorldView-3, WorldView-4, GeoEye-1 |
| `airbus_oneatlas` | Airbus OneAtlas | API key | no | yes | yes | Pléiades, SPOT 6, SPOT 7 |
| `alaska_satellite_facility` | Alaska Satellite Facility | earthdata | yes | no | no | Sentinel-1, ALOS PALSAR, ALOS-2 |
| `noaa_big_data` | NOAA Big Data | None | no | no | no | GOES-16, GOES-17, GOES-18, NEXRAD |
| `google_earth_engine` | Google Earth Engine | service_account | yes | no | no | All GEE catalog (Landsat, Sentinel, MODIS, etc.) |
| `terrabotics` | TerraBotics | API key | no | yes | no | Archive tasking |
| `aws_earth` | AWS Earth Open Data | None | no | no | yes | Sentinel-2, Landsat, NAIP, MODIS |
| `planetary_computer` | Microsoft Planetary Computer | None | yes | no | yes | Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Landsat, MODIS, NAIP, Copernicus DEM |
| `element84` | Element 84 Earth Search | None | no | no | yes | Sentinel-2, Landsat Collection 2 |
| `esa_scihub` | ESA SciHub Mirror | None | yes | no | no | Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3 |
| `jaxa_earth` | JAXA ALOS World | None | yes | no | no | ALOS World 3D DSM, PALSAR-2 |
| `isro_bhuvan` | ISRO Bhuvan | None | no | no | no | ResourceSat-2/2A, Cartosat-1/2, Oceansat-3 |
| `inpe_cbers` | INPE CBERS | None | no | no | no | CBERS-4, CBERS-4A |
| `digitalglobe` | DigitalGlobe Open Data | None | no | yes | no | Various VHR disaster imagery |
| `geoserver_generic` | GeoServer (Generic OGC) | Depends on the server you point it at | no | no | no | Any OGC-compatible service |

*Account:* "No account" providers are used by default and need nothing from you. *≤ 1 m*: sub-metre commercial imagery, which is usually paid.

## Provider details

### `usgs`

**USGS Earth Explorer**: Landsat 1-9, ASTER, MODIS via USGS Earth Explorer.

- Access: Username and password
- Serves: Landsat 1-9, ASTER, MODIS
- Radar: no · Sub-metre: no · STAC: no
- Endpoint: `https://m2m.cr.usgs.gov/api/api/json/stable/`

### `copernicus`

**Copernicus CDSE**: Full Copernicus programme — Sentinel-1/2/3/5P.

- Access: OAuth2 (client id / secret or account)
- Serves: Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3, Sentinel-5P
- Radar: yes · Sub-metre: no · STAC: yes
- Endpoint: `https://catalogue.dataspace.copernicus.eu/resto/api/`
- STAC API: `https://catalogue.dataspace.copernicus.eu/stac`

### `nasa_earthdata`

**NASA Earthdata CMR**: NASA CMR — MODIS, VIIRS, ICESat-2, GEDI.

- Access: OAuth2 (client id / secret or account)
- Serves: MODIS, VIIRS, ICESat-2, GEDI
- Radar: no · Sub-metre: no · STAC: yes
- Endpoint: `https://cmr.earthdata.nasa.gov/stac/`
- STAC API: `https://cmr.earthdata.nasa.gov/stac/`

### `nasa_earthdata_cloud`

**NASA Earthdata Cloud**: Cloud-hosted NASA data via direct S3 access.

- Access: OAuth2 plus temporary S3 credentials
- Serves: All NASA cloud-hosted datasets
- Radar: no · Sub-metre: no · STAC: yes
- Endpoint: `https://cmr.earthdata.nasa.gov/cloudstac/`
- STAC API: `https://cmr.earthdata.nasa.gov/cloudstac/`

### `opentopography`

**OpenTopography**: SRTM, Copernicus DEM 30/90m, LiDAR point clouds.

- Access: API key
- Serves: SRTM, Copernicus DEM, ALOS, LiDAR
- Radar: no · Sub-metre: no · STAC: no
- Endpoint: `https://portal.opentopography.org/API/`

### `planet`

**Planet Labs**: Daily 3-5m PlanetScope, 0.5m SkySat.

- Access: API key
- Serves: PlanetScope, SkySat, RapidEye
- Radar: no · Sub-metre: yes · STAC: yes
- Endpoint: `https://api.planet.com/data/v1/`

### `sentinel_hub`

**Sentinel Hub**: Sentinel Hub EO Browser — all Sentinels + Landsat.

- Access: OAuth2 (client id / secret or account)
- Serves: Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3, Landsat, MODIS
- Radar: yes · Sub-metre: no · STAC: no
- Endpoint: `https://services.sentinel-hub.com/`

### `maxar_gbdx`

**Maxar GBDX**: WorldView constellation — 30cm resolution.

- Access: Access token
- Serves: WorldView-1, WorldView-2, WorldView-3, WorldView-4, GeoEye-1
- Radar: no · Sub-metre: yes · STAC: no
- Endpoint: `https://evwhs.digitalglobe.com/`

### `airbus_oneatlas`

**Airbus OneAtlas**: Pléiades 50cm, SPOT 1.5m.

- Access: API key
- Serves: Pléiades, SPOT 6, SPOT 7
- Radar: no · Sub-metre: yes · STAC: yes
- Endpoint: `https://api.oneatlas.airbus.com/`

### `alaska_satellite_facility`

**Alaska Satellite Facility**: SAR specialist — Sentinel-1 C-band, ALOS L-band.

- Access: earthdata
- Serves: Sentinel-1, ALOS PALSAR, ALOS-2
- Radar: yes · Sub-metre: no · STAC: no

**NOAA Big Data**: GOES weather satellites, NEXRAD radar (open access).

- Access: None (open)
- Serves: GOES-16, GOES-17, GOES-18, NEXRAD
- Radar: no · Sub-metre: no · STAC: no
- Endpoint: `https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-goes/`

**Google Earth Engine**: Multi-petabyte GEE catalog via API.

**GeoServer (Generic OGC)**: Generic WMS/WCS/WFS GeoServer integration.

## Which provider for which satellite

When you give a satellite name instead of providers, these are tried in this order.

| Satellite / product | Providers, best first |
|---|---|
| `sentinel-2` | `planetary_computer` → `copernicus` → `aws_earth` → `element84` → `sentinel_hub` |
| `sentinel-1` | `copernicus` → `alaska_satellite_facility` → `planetary_computer` → `sentinel_hub` |
| `sentinel-3` | `copernicus` → `sentinel_hub` |
| `sentinel-5p` | `copernicus` |
| `landsat` | `planetary_computer` → `usgs` → `aws_earth` → `element84` → `sentinel_hub` |
| `landsat-9` | `planetary_computer` → `usgs` → `aws_earth` |
| `landsat-8` | `planetary_computer` → `usgs` → `aws_earth` |
| `modis` | `nasa_earthdata` → `planetary_computer` → `sentinel_hub` |
| `naip` | `planetary_computer` → `aws_earth` |
| `planet` | `planet` |
| `planetscope` | `planet` |
| `skysat` | `planet` |
| `worldview` | `maxar_gbdx` |
| `pleiades` | `airbus_oneatlas` |
| `spot` | `airbus_oneatlas` |
| `goes` | `noaa_big_data` |
| `nexrad` | `noaa_big_data` |
| `aster` | `usgs` → `planetary_computer` |
| `alos` | `jaxa_earth` → `alaska_satellite_facility` |
| `dem` | `planetary_computer` → `opentopography` → `aws_earth` |
| `srtm` | `opentopography` → `planetary_computer` |
| `cop-dem` | `planetary_computer` → `aws_earth` |
| `viirs` | `nasa_earthdata` |
| `icesat-2` | `nasa_earthdata` |
| `gedi` | `nasa_earthdata` |
| `cbers` | `inpe_cbers` |
| `resourcesat` | `isro_bhuvan` |
| `cartosat` | `isro_bhuvan` |

## Using a provider

```python
from pygeovision import PyGeoVision

client = PyGeoVision()
scenes = client.search(bbox=(-0.30, 5.55, -0.10, 5.70), date_range=("2024-06-01", "2024-06-30"),
                       providers=["planetary_computer"], cloud_cover_max=20)
```

```bash
pygeovision data providers                 # list providers and whether they are configured
pygeovision data auth add copernicus       # store credentials
pygeovision data auth test copernicus      # check them
pygeovision data search --bbox -0.30 5.55 -0.10 5.70 --provider planetary_computer
```

See [Search and download](search-and-download.md) for the results you get back and [Authentication](authentication.md) for storing credentials safely.
